tasks.name: סוג המשולש
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ if(!a||!b||!c||a+b<=c||a+c<=b||b+c<=a) return 0; if(a===b&&b===c) return 1; if(a===b||b===c||a===c) return 2; return 3; }
tasks.note: Triangle classifier from three side lengths: 0 invalid (needs pair sums up to 30), 1 equilateral, 2 isosceles, 3 scalene.

tasks.name: חלוקת חשבון
tasks.note: Split a two-item bill a+b among n people, rounding each share up, capped at 15; n=0 gives 0.

tasks.name: הקרוב ל-10
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ let best=a; for(const x of [b,c]){ const d=Math.abs(x-10), bd=Math.abs(best-10); if(d<bd||(d===bd&&x>best)) best=x; } return best; }
tasks.note: Picks the input closest to a fixed target 10, breaking distance ties in favour of the larger value.

tasks.name: ספרת האחדות של המכפלה
tasks.note: Last decimal digit of the product a*b, a non-power-of-two modulus on a value up to 225.

tasks.name: חיבור רווי עם סימן
tasks.note: Signed 4-bit addition (8..15 = -8..-1) that saturates at 7 and -8 instead of wrapping.

tasks.name: קבע את ביט ב לערך ג
tasks.note: Writes the parity bit of c into bit (b mod 4) of a: set it if c is odd, clear it if c is even.

tasks.name: מספר פסגות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i]>l[i-1]&&l[i]>l[i+1]) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts interior local maxima, each compared with both neighbours; the ends never count.

tasks.name: הקפיצה הגדולה
tasks.src: l=>{ let m=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) m=Math.max(m,Math.abs(l[i]-l[i-1])); return m; }
tasks.note: Largest absolute difference between neighbouring elements (biggest price swing); fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: רווח מקסימלי ממניה
tasks.src: l=>{ let m=0, lo=16; for(const x of l){ if(x-lo>m) m=x-lo; if(x<lo) lo=x; } return m; }
tasks.note: Best buy-then-sell profit: max of l[j]-l[i] over i<j, 0 if prices never rise.

tasks.name: דלי הדירוג של הממוצע
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length; if(!n) return 0; const s=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); return s<10*n?1:(s<12*n?2:3); }
tasks.note: Buckets the mean rating without dividing: 1 if mean<10, 2 if mean<12, else 3; empty list gives 0.

tasks.name: מדליית ארד
tasks.note: Third largest value (bronze medal); 0 when the list has fewer than 3 elements.

tasks.name: גדולים מהאחרון
tasks.note: Counts elements larger than the last element; 0 for an empty list.

tasks.name: מספר היפוכים
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) if(l[i]>l[j]) c++; return Math.min(c,15); }
tasks.note: Total number of inverted pairs (i<j with l[i]>l[j]), capped at 15 since it can reach 28.

tasks.name: התא הפנוי הבא
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 8; let v=l[l.length-1]; for(let k=0;k<7;k++){ v=v===15?8:v+1; if(!l.includes(v)) return v; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Round-robin locker allocation: the first locker in 8..15 not taken, searching cyclically after the most recently taken one (last element); empty gives 8, all taken gives 0.

tasks.name: ארגזים של 10
tasks.note: Packing: total (up to 92) divided by a capacity of 10, rounded up, i.e. boxes needed (empty gives 0).

tasks.name: רק 9, 12, 14
tasks.note: Keeps only members of the fixed set {9,12,14}, preserving order.

tasks.name: רק מעל 11
tasks.note: Keeps elements greater than 11 (i.e. 12..15) in original order.

tasks.name: זוגיות הפוכה לראשון
tasks.note: Keeps only elements whose parity differs from the first element's parity (so the first is always dropped).

tasks.name: שלושת האחרונים, החדש ראשון
tasks.note: Recent-items view: the last three elements, most recent first.

tasks.name: הקרוב ל-12 קודם
tasks.note: Nearest-to-target ordering: sorts by distance from 12, ties broken by the smaller value first.

tasks.name: מגמת הפתיחה
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; const up=l[1]>l[0], r=[l[0],l[1]]; for(let i=2;i<l.length;i++){ if(up?l[i]>l[i-1]:l[i]<l[i-1]) r.push(l[i]); else break; } return r; }
tasks.note: Direction decided by the data: the first step sets rising or falling, then keeps the longest prefix that continues in that same direction.

tasks.name: היפוך כל חצי
tasks.note: Splits at floor(n/2) and reverses each half separately (the longer half is the second one).

tasks.name: העמוד האחרון
tasks.note: Pagination with 3 items per page: returns the items on the last page (1 to 3 items), empty for an empty list.

tasks.name: סבב בטורניר
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i+=2) r.push(i+1<l.length?Math.max(l[i],l[i+1]):l[i]); return r; }
tasks.note: Knockout round: the larger of each adjacent pair advances, and an unpaired last element advances automatically.
